Summary:
The DotSlash dev container feature fails to install, which breaks folly's "Development Container-Based CI" GitHub workflow on every push since D128175160 got it past the feature lookup (e.g. https://github.com/meta/folly/actions/runs/40798706658): `install.sh` downloads from `github.com/facebook/dotslash`, which now answers 301 with a redirect to `github.com/meta/dotslash`, and its check accepts only 200 and 302, so it stops with "Failed to download version latest!  Does it exist?".

Download from `github.com/meta/dotslash` and follow redirects in the check, expecting 200, so another redirect does not break it again. Bump the feature to 1.0.1 for publishing, and point the docs and `documentationURL` at the `meta` org and the feature's actual path.

The published feature changes only when someone runs the "Release DotSlash Dev Container Feature" workflow on GitHub after this lands; `ghcr.io/meta/devcontainers/features/dotslash:1`, which folly uses, then resolves to 1.0.1.

Reviewed By: genevievehelsel

Differential Revision: D128230910
